data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 57.6m in 2016 driven primarily by favourable claims development and proactive claims handling. The balance sheet gross claims outstanding increased materially during 2016 due to the acceptance of Syndicate 1400's 2013 RITC (c. GBP 248.8m gross added) and foreign exchange movements. Specific 2016 events (Alberta wildfire and Hurricane Matthew) impacted current year results but the prior year release reflects improved development on older years. RITC acceptance distorts direct gross prior-year movement metrics; a gross PYD figure was not explicitly stated, so the reported net release is used as the primary quantified measure.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (PYD) figure was presented in the 'movement in prior year's provision' note; a gross claims development triangle exists but is distorted by the acceptance of Syndicate 1400's 2013 RITC (gross RITC = GBP 248.822k) which materially increases gross reserves and makes triangle-based PYD calculations unreliable. The report explicitly states a NET prior year release of GBP 57.6m; per extraction rules this NET figure is used as a last-resort quantified prior-year movement and flagged accordingly. Some LOB-specific PYD figures are not provided; LOB movements are inferred and low confidence except where the RITC gross amount is explicit.
